context: A teacher walks a teen through a project
purpose: Teach: 探っ/効か/呪い/治っ/振ら/古今/身元/速攻

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、地域の謎、地道に探ったんですね。
lines.en: Sakura, you really did track down those regional patterns carefully, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Measured pace, slightly drawn out. Genuine approval settling into the words. The tone of a teacher noticing real work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。広報が効かない地域、章にしました。
lines.en: Yes. I focused on areas where standard PR methods weren't reaching.
lines.style: Direct but not guarded. Steady delivery. Pride in the work, not in herself. Speaking from the centre of what she understands.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古い呪いの伝説、文化人類学的に扱いましたね。
lines.en: And you handled the old legends with real anthropological depth—I noticed that.
lines.style: Thoughtful, specific. Slight pause before the second clause. Not generic praise—naming what was actually there. Quiet satisfaction in her voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史の傷が治った地域、復活の例、書きました。
lines.en: Yes. I documented regions where old wounds had healed, and traced how they came back.
lines.style: Clear, methodical. The words flow like someone laying out what she found. No stumbling. Quiet confidence underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 観光宣伝に振らされない地域、貴重ですね。
lines.en: That's rare—studying communities that haven't been flattened by tourism narratives.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. A small smile in the voice. Appreciating what Sakura saw that others might miss. Warm but not effusive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 古今の地域研究、比較しました。
lines.en: I compared how regional identity works across different time periods.
lines.style: Simple statement. No elaboration needed. Delivered with understated competence. The tone of someone explaining what she actually did.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 資料の身元、出典、明示しましたね。
lines.en: Your sources are all properly documented—I can see where everything comes from.
lines.style: Specific approval. Slight nod in the voice. This matters to her—rigour matters. Warm and exacting at once.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 速攻での結論、慎重に書きました。
lines.en: I was careful not to rush to conclusions.
lines.style: Quiet closure. Slight finality. Speaking more to herself than defending. The kind of understatement that means she knows what she did well.
